title: Shinkai 6500 科學潛器
summary: 以Shinkai 6500的公開科學研究背景，練習母船、觀測載具與樣本室之間的介面；把樣本編號、能量和質量變化一一對應。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use the public scientific context of Shinkai 6500 to examine interfaces among support vessel, observation vehicle and sample laboratory, linking sample IDs to energy and mass changes. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 核對母船與載具深度資料的基準：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Align support-ship and vehicle depth datums: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 核對母船與載具深度資料的基準 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Align support-ship and vehicle depth datums and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 核對母船與載具深度資料的基準：靜水壓差由上方水柱重量造成；表壓與絕對壓力相差水面壓力。 本步以「深度與靜水壓差」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Align support-ship and vehicle depth datums: Hydrostatic pressure difference comes from the water-column weight; gauge and absolute pressure differ by surface pressure. Use Depth and hydrostatic pressure difference to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Shinkai 6500 科學潛器實際規格：ρ=1025 kg/m³，g=9.81 m/s²，教學深度h=108 m。式 Δp=ρgh，基準結果 1.085967 MPa。條件：定密度線性近似；深海精算須積分密度剖面。本式不能給出耐壓艙安全深度。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Shinkai 6500 research submersible: ρ=1025 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s², hypothetical depth h=108 m. Formula Δp=ρgh gives 1.085967 MPa. Conditions: Constant-density linear approximation; deep-ocean calculations require integrating density profiles. This does not establish a housing’s safe depth.
steps.failure: 把MPa當bar會造成十倍錯誤；壓力曲線合理也不能證明結構耐壓能力。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Treating MPa as bar causes a tenfold error; a plausible pressure trace does not establish structural pressure resistance. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 用虛構壓力記錄減去水面讀值，檢查零點、單位和隨深度斜率；禁止以自製容器加壓驗證。 本案例另須檢查「核對母船與載具深度資料的基準」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Subtract surface readings from synthetic pressure records and inspect zero, units and depth slope; do not validate by pressurizing homemade vessels. Also check that Align support-ship and vehicle depth datums and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：核對母船與載具深度資料的基準。在母船與載具介面圖、樣本籃及虛構感測紀錄完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加深度10%，以同一密度比較壓差。 算式區的基準值為1.085967，改變後為1.1945637 MPa。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Align support-ship and vehicle depth datums. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Support-ship interface diagram, sample basket and synthetic sensor logs. Increase depth alone by 10% and compare pressure difference at fixed density. Baseline 1.085967 changes to 1.1945637 MPa. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger.
